input.purpose: Measure V_lab for commissioning /habitat/lab/eclss/scrubber-1-v10 by fitting the Lab CO2 decay time constant and applying V_lab = Qe × tau.
hypotheses: The Lab is one well-mixed zone during the test.
The hatch between /habitat/lab and /habitat/hab-b remains closed and in the same position throughout.
Exchange through the closed hatch is small enough not to dominate the fitted Lab decay; this test does not measure that exchange.
The single Lab occupant remains in the Lab at steady activity for the entire test, so the occupant CO2 source is approximately steady.
The scrubber's registered effective flow versus accepted speed is valid for calculating V_lab = Qe × tau.
Fit the full-speed decay toward a fitted nonzero equilibrium using C(t) = C_eq + (C_0 - C_eq) exp(-t/tau).

monitoring.reason: The test intentionally raises CO2 in the occupied Lab; stop on an out-of-band vital sign, lost monitoring, or occupancy change.

steps.why: Hold the Lab as one zone and reduce scrubber flow until CO2 rises several hundred ppm above the measured 1450 ppm start, without exceeding the limit; record Lab and Hab-B CO2, accepted speed, and hatch state at one-minute intervals.
Return to full speed and record the decay at one-minute intervals; fit the nonzero-equilibrium exponential to obtain tau and calculate V_lab = Qe × tau.

abort.when: Lab CO2 is at or above limits.co2AbortPpm, or the CO2 reading is unavailable.
The scrubber refuses either commanded speed or acceptance cannot be confirmed.
Scrubber battery state of charge is below threshold percent or cannot be read.
CDR is outside the stated heart-rate band, monitoring is lost, or any person enters or leaves the Lab.

expected.rise: At 30% speed, Lab CO2 should rise from the measured 1450 ppm start by several hundred ppm while remaining below 2800 ppm.
expected.decay: At 100% speed, Lab CO2 should follow a smooth exponential toward a fitted nonzero equilibrium; the fitted tau combined with registered effective flow should yield V_lab = Qe × tau.
expected.opening_check: With the hatch closed, Hab-B CO2 should not show a prompt curve matching the Lab; a matching response would reject the negligible-exchange hypothesis.
expected.source_check: The CDR remains in the Lab at steady activity; an occupancy change invalidates the curve and triggers abort.
expected.hypothesis_failure: Reject or repeat the fit if CO2 does not rise clearly above sensor noise, the full-speed trace is not well described by a single exponential toward nonzero equilibrium, speed is not accepted, the hatch position changes, or Hab-B tracks the Lab closely.
